name: WebMIDI
description: Web MIDI device discovery, port lifecycle, typed state and message events, and binary message transport.

reviewedExclusions.rationale: The assignable event-handler property is excluded in favor of the typed statechange descriptor subscription, which has explicit callback lifetime and disposal.
The assignable event-handler property is excluded in favor of the typed statechange descriptor subscription, which has explicit callback lifetime and disposal.
The assignable event-handler property is excluded in favor of the typed midimessage descriptor subscription, preserving borrowed event ownership and binary data.
Callback enumeration is excluded because the callback exposes borrowed values and the parent map; live size, has, and get operations preserve ownership without widening callback transport.
